answers.title: How do I reset a forgotten account password?
answers.body: Choose Forgot password on the sign-in page. Enter your account email, then use the reset link. The link expires after 30 minutes. Support cannot read your password.
answers.source: Authored demo handbook / Account / Password reset

answers.title: How do I download my workspace data as a CSV export?
answers.body: A workspace owner can open Settings, choose Export data, and select CSV. The export includes records visible to that owner. Large exports may take several minutes.
answers.source: Authored demo handbook / Workspace / Data export

answers.title: How can I stop the daily email digest notifications?
answers.body: Open Profile, then Notifications. Switch Daily digest off and save. This changes digest messages only; security notifications remain enabled.
